parsed.name: CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
parsed.description: Sunpower CryoTel GT 是一款实验室用低温制冷机，用于提供和维持低温环境，可读取当前温度并设置温度或功率设定值。
parsed.description_en: The Sunpower CryoTel GT is a laboratory cryocooler used to provide and maintain low-temperature conditions, with readback of the current temperature and adjustable temperature or power setpoints.
